_comment: SELF-HOST overlay for scripts/named-workflows.json (owner decision 2026-11-14). Read only when seed-named-workflows.ts runs with --self-host (npm run db:seed passes it). `install`: full definitions that replace the snapshot's on a self-host - they call only services a self-host has. `examples`: snapshot workflows seeded PAUSED, each needing a service a self-host does not have. Every other snapshot workflow is NOT created on a self-host. The snapshot itself is untouched, so production's set is unchanged.

install.name: pov-status-report
install.description:
List the projects (POVs) that are In Progress.

WHAT IT DOES:
1. Lists up to 10 projects whose status is IN_PROGRESS, with title, customer, status and priority

WHEN TO USE:
- A quick status check before a meeting
- Portfolio health check

NOTE: a new project starts as PROJECTED. Set it to In Progress (Edit POV) for it to appear here. With none in progress the workflow completes with an empty list.

EXAMPLE:
services({ action: "workflow.execute", workflowName: "pov-status-report" })

install.name: weekly-pov-digest
install.description:
Generate a digest of all projects (POVs) by status.

WHAT IT DOES:
1. Lists IN_PROGRESS projects
2. Lists VALIDATION projects (ready to close)
3. Lists STALLED projects (need attention)

WHEN TO USE:
- Weekly management reports
- Monday morning status sync
- Portfolio review meetings

NOTE: a new project starts as PROJECTED and appears in none of the three lists until its status is changed (Edit POV).

EXAMPLE:
services({ action: "workflow.execute", workflowName: "weekly-pov-digest" })

install.name: screenshot-documentation
install.description:
Capture a screenshot and a PDF of a web page.

WHAT IT DOES:
1. Takes a full-page screenshot of https://example.com
2. Generates a PDF version of the page

NEEDS: the Browser Automation Service (npm run seed:browser-service, and its container running).

TO CAPTURE YOUR OWN PAGE: run the same two steps inline with your URL (services workflow.execute with `steps`). The page must be public: a page behind a login captures the login screen, and private-network addresses are refused.

EXAMPLE:
services({ action: "workflow.execute", workflowName: "screenshot-documentation" })

task-completion-notify.warning: When it runs it COMPLETES the first In Progress task it finds.
